user.title: Connect Cook4Me
user.description: Sign in with your KRUPS account. Account-owned Cook4Me appliances are resolved automatically; no appliance UUID is required.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Cook4Me discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered {device} locally over the Cook4Me Bluetooth protocol. Sign in to your KRUPS account to securely match it to an appliance owned by your account.

appliance.title: Choose Cook4Me
appliance.description: More than one compatible Cook4Me appliance is owned by this KRUPS account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the KRUPS/Cook4Me cloud
error.no_appliances: No compatible Cook4Me appliance was found on this KRUPS account
error.cloud_unavailable: The KRUPS/Cook4Me cloud is temporarily unavailable
error.discovery_failed: Signed in successfully, but your Cook4Me appliance could not be resolved from the KRUPS account
error.internal_error: Cook4Me integration error. Check the Home Assistant log for the sanitized diagnostic

abort.discovery_expired: Cook4Me discovery expired; start setup again
